title: Connect to Desktop
subtitle: Your phone is the remote — the Nomifun desktop does the heavy lifting
scanHint: Enable "WebUI remote access" under Open Capabilities on the desktop, then scan the QR on that panel
manualHint: Use the LAN address shown on the desktop
passwordHint: The password is shown on the desktop WebUI remote-access panel
probeFailed: Can't reach the server — make sure the phone and computer share the same Wi-Fi and WebUI remote access is enabled
notNomifun: That address is not a Nomifun server
qrInvalid: Not a Nomifun connection QR code
qrExpired: QR code expired or already used — refresh it on the desktop and scan again
rateLimited: Too many attempts — wait 15 minutes and try again
setupHint: This is a fresh server — claim the admin account
cameraPermission: Camera permission is required to scan
pasteLinkHint: You can also paste the URL encoded in the QR code
disconnectConfirm: You'll need to scan or log in again to reconnect
webSameOrigin: Web build connects to the current site
